title: 6''-O-acetylsaikosaponin D targets STAT3-mediated transcriptional remodeling to induce ferroptosis and apoptosis.
authors: Li, Xuehui; Qiao, Yunxiao; Xu, Xinyi; Zhu, Jinyu; Xie, Chuang; Lin, Shan; Xu, Lingfan; Yuan, Fuwen
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物6''-O-acSSD通过靶向STAT3转录重编程诱导铁死亡和凋亡，虽涉及STAT3-DNA结合（CUT&Tag）和分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物抗肿瘤机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法应用浅层，与课题关联有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Natural products from traditional medicinal plants represent an important source of anti-cancer agents and lead compounds for drug development. Saikosaponin D (SSD), a triterpenoid saponin isolated from Radix Bupleuri, exhibits anti-tumor activity but is limited by a narrow therapeutic window and cytotoxicity. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate the anti-tumor activity of 6''-O-acetylsaikosaponin D (6''-O-acSSD), a naturally occurring acetylated derivative of Saikosaponin D that is identified in Radix Bupleuri, and to elucidate its underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: The anti-cancer effects of 6''-O-acSSD were assessed using multiple cancer cell models, three-dimensional tumor spheroids, and patient-derived tumor organoids. Transcriptomic and bioinformatic analyses were performed to identify regulated cell death pathways. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, cellular thermal shift assays, western blotting, and CUT&Tag profiling were used to identify molecular targets and define transcriptional reprogramming. RESULTS: 6''-O-acSSD markedly suppressed cancer cell proliferation, migration, and invasion and elicited a transcriptional program distinct from that induced by SSD. Transcriptomic and biochemical analyses revealed preferential activation of ferroptosis-associated signatures, including enhanced lipid peroxidation. Mechanistically, 6''-O-acSSD engaged STAT3, inhibited its phosphorylation, and extensively remodeled STAT3 chromatin occupancy. Functional analyses showed that STAT3 inhibition was required for the full anti-tumor activity of 6''-O-acSSD. Notably, blockade of ferroptosis only partially rescued cell viability, whereas STAT3 targeting additionally triggered apoptosis-associated transcriptional and biochemical changes. The anti-tumor effects of 6''-O-acSSD were further validated in patient-derived tumor organoids. CONCLUSION: 6''-O-acSSD exerts potent anti-tumor effects by targeting STAT3-dependent transcriptional programs and inducing coordinated ferroptosis and apoptosis. These findings highlight the therapeutic potential of structurally optimized natural products for anti-cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：来自传统药用植物的天然产物是抗癌药物和药物开发先导化合物的重要来源。柴胡皂苷D（Saikosaponin D, SSD）是从柴胡（Radix Bupleuri）中分离得到的一种三萜皂苷，具有抗肿瘤活性，但受限于狭窄的治疗窗口和细胞毒性。目的：本研究旨在评估6''-O-乙酰柴胡皂苷D（6''-O-acSSD）的抗肿瘤活性，该化合物是柴胡中鉴定出的柴胡皂苷D的天然乙酰化衍生物，并阐明其潜在分子机制。方法：使用多种癌细胞模型、三维肿瘤球体和患者来源的肿瘤类器官评估6''-O-acSSD的抗癌效果。通过转录组学和生物信息学分析鉴定受调控的细胞死亡通路。采用分子对接、分子动力学模拟、细胞热位移分析、蛋白质印迹和CUT&Tag分析来识别分子靶点并定义转录重编程。结果：6''-O-acSSD显著抑制癌细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，并诱导出与SSD不同的转录程序。转录组学和生化分析揭示其优先激活铁死亡相关特征，包括增强的脂质过氧化。机制上，6''-O-acSSD与STAT3结合，抑制其磷酸化，并广泛重塑STAT3染色质占据。功能分析表明，STAT3抑制是6''-O-acSSD完全抗肿瘤活性所必需的。值得注意的是，阻断铁死亡仅部分恢复细胞活力，而靶向STAT3还额外触发凋亡相关的转录和生化变化。6''-O-acSSD的抗肿瘤效果在患者来源的肿瘤类器官中得到进一步验证。结论：6''-O-acSSD通过靶向STAT3依赖性转录程序并诱导铁死亡和凋亡的协同作用发挥强效抗肿瘤效果。这些发现突显了结构优化的天然产物在抗癌治疗中的治疗潜力。
